summary: First full-stack test of the HomeServe ecosystem (Customer, Partner, Admin on one API/DB). Backend: 44 pytest tests across 2 files (existing test_homeserve_api.py with 33 tests plus a new test_homeserve_extra.py with 11) all pass when run serially (-n0). Covered: auth, role guards (403), catalog, coupons (FIRST50/SAVE100/ACFEST), surge, GST, the full booking lifecycle with extras, cancel fees 0/49/99, wallet, decline counter + the ₹50 penalty on every 3rd decline, settlements, payouts, KYC, SOS and commission bounds. Frontend: Playwright ran the END-TO-END cross-app flow end to end with no blockers. Customer books with UPI and SAVE100 -> partner 9000000001 goes online -> incoming modal (15s countdown, distance, earning) -> Accept -> Start Navigation / Arrived -> customer sees ETA, partner card and start OTP -> wrong OTP is rejected, correct OTP starts the job -> extra part requested -> customer approval dialog -> Complete is disabled while the extra is pending -> approve -> complete with end OTP -> invoice GST/2026/10006 -> 4★ rating + tip -> customer GST invoice -> Re-book goes to checkout. Also verified in the UI: portal links, OTP login, new-number onboarding (/app/profile?onboard=1), location sheet, category grid, trending, book-again, services, service detail, checkout, profile, address add/delete, wallet top-up, chatbot + ticket, chat, masked call, customer cancel. Admin: KPIs, charts, fraud alerts, search, notifications, live bookings, re-assign dialog, cities, surge rules, coupons, KYC, partners, SOS resolve, payout paid, commission, settlements, invoices. Partner: skills, bank details, schedule, earnings, withdraw, SOS. Found 1 security bug (brute-force lockout can be bypassed), 1 medium UX bug (DL renewal blocked) and several minor issues.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout can be bypassed. The lock identifier is request.client.host + email, and behind the k8s ingress client.host is the ingress pod IP, which rotates. 6 bad attempts were spread over 2 identifiers (count 4 and 2), so 429 was never returned. Fix: use the first IP in X-Forwarded-For, or key on email only.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS is '*' with allow_credentials=True, so Starlette echoes any Origin (seen: ACAO https://evil.example.com, ACAC true). Set explicit origins. Risk is lower because auth uses Bearer tokens in localStorage, not cookies; no httpOnly cookies are set (the auth playbook expects cookies).

On prepaid (UPI/Card/Wallet) bookings an approved extra raises pricing.total (paid ₹1,360.30, invoice ₹1,655.30), but the ₹295 difference is never charged. Complete just sets amount_paid=total and payment_status=paid. Track a balance due or collect it.
Increments consecutive_rejections even when the booking was not offered to this partner, because the update_one result is not checked. A partner can rack up penalties by calling it with any id.
Labelled weekly (period = last 7 days) but includes ALL unsettled completed jobs of any age (e.g. 31 jobs for Ramesh). COD cash the partner already holds is not netted against net_payable.
A coupon's used_count is not decremented when its booking is cancelled.
Lists every partner, including offline, KYC-unapproved and nameless test partners, and each has an active Assign button. Consider filtering out or disabling non-approved ones.

ui_bugs.issue: Approved documents hide the upload form, so a partner whose approved DL expires in 20 days cannot renew it, even though the dashboard alert says 'Renew & re-upload'. Show the upload/renew form when an approved doc is within 30 days of expiry.
After deleting the selected city, the right panel still shows the deleted city's geofence and Save button (stale selection), and no success toast appears.

No stale-request guard. Clicking a tab and then typing a search fires overlapping requests, and an older response can overwrite the filtered one: searching HS284119 showed 141 rows until the next 5s poll. Use AbortController or a request-id check.
The search results popover stays open when the notifications popover opens, so the two overlap.

issues: The bottom sheet spans the full 1920px viewport instead of staying inside the 412px phone frame.

design_issues.screen: Admin Surge & Promos dialogs / Customer profile
issues: Native HTML <select> for trigger type, city, discount type and language, and a native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) for coupon valid-till. Use shadcn Select and Calendar.
Surge start/end hour inputs have no labels.
Uses window.confirm; use a shadcn AlertDialog that states the applicable fee.
Negative amounts are formatted '₹-10,110.43'; should be '-₹10,110.43'.
The SOS floating button overlaps list content near the bottom-right (e.g. the Schedule jobs list).
Copy reads '(1 categories mix allowed)' – fix the pluralisation.
A new city's map opens on a default center in central India rather than the city's location; the surge label shows a trailing 'Surge 1.1x ·' when no reason is given.
The balance shows ₹0 while loading instead of a skeleton.

action_items: Fix the admin login brute-force lockout identifier: use X-Forwarded-For first IP, or email only.
Restrict CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins when allow_credentials=True.
Allow renewal/re-upload of approved DL/Police docs that are near expiry (PProfile).
Handle the payment delta for approved extras on prepaid bookings.
Validate in decline that the booking was actually offered to the partner before incrementing rejections.
Clear the selected city after delete in ACities and show a toast.
Replace native selects/date input with shadcn components; keep the location sheet inside the phone frame.

Test suite: test classes in test_homeserve_api.py share the demo customer's cart, so they race under the configured xdist -n 2 loadscope (seen 'Cart is empty' failures). Use separate customers per class, or mark them to share a worker. The suite also creates nameless partners each run without teardown; add cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.admin_login: the lockout key depends on the proxy IP; see the HIGH issue.
routes_partner.decline: unchecked update result lets a partner inflate rejections and penalties.
routes_partner.complete: amount_paid is overwritten with the new total without collecting the extras difference.
logic.surge_for_city takes the max multiplier rather than stacking. This matches the UI copy ('Highest active multiplier applies'); confirm that is intended versus 1.2x * 1.3x.
Bcrypt hash format $2b$ OK; seed_admin re-hashes the admin password if it changed (OK); tokens are Bearer in localStorage (no httpOnly cookie).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_homeserve_api.py (test_wallet_insufficient: qty 5 -> 99 so it no longer depends on the demo wallet balance)

Removed 5 nameless test partners left by the test suite. Side effects: the demo customer wallet is inflated (~₹22k+) by refunds and cashbacks; Ramesh's wallet changed (₹1 withdrawals plus one settlement released by the test) and is now ₹3,420.92; one test SOS was resolved; 2 payouts were marked paid; a new test customer (7xxxxxxxxx) and ticket TKT73751 remain; booking HS284119 is completed and rated 4★.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend suite with `-n 0` (serial) to avoid cart races on the shared demo customer. Dispatch is pull-based: the partner must be online, and it picks the oldest pending booking in its skills first, so leftover pending AC/Elec/Clean/Plumb/Appliance bookings will be offered before new ones (the test helper wait_offer declines others). Partner 9000000001 was left OFFLINE with no live jobs. Seeded live jobs: usr_p2 assigned + en_route, usr_p3 in_progress, plus 1 pending painting booking HS539961 (seeded; one seeded pending salon booking was no longer pending at the end — not investigated). Screenshots must use the .jpg extension.
rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout bypass: identifier = f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. In the preview/prod k8s setup, requests reach uvicorn from rotating ingress pod IPs (seen 10.227.1.198 and 10.227.1.200), so failed attempts split across multiple keys and never reach 5. Reproduce: POST /api/auth/admin/login with a wrong password 6 times -> all 401, and db.login_attempts has 2 docs. Fix: derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For[0], or count per email.
